set.body: Solidify the fmriAR/fmrireg-derived autocorrelation and GLS engine beyond happy-path regression tests. Scope: cross-target numerical invariants, differential/parity fixtures, adversarial AR stability and censor/run layouts, multirun GLS, and performance guardrails for the shared computational core. Acceptance: every child slice has JVM and Scala.js tests where applicable; any JVM-only parity/performance fixtures are explicitly isolated; test failures indicate a clear mathematical contract violation rather than only snapshot drift.
set.title: Epic: AR/GLS statistical hardening
